bullets.text: AI Takes Center Stage - Super Bowl LX ads prominently feature AI, showcasing its growing influence in advertising.
Waymo's Ambitious Plans - With $16 billion, Waymo aims to expand its robotaxi services to more cities, including London.
Spotify's New Book Venture - Spotify will allow UK and US subscribers to purchase physical books through its app.
OpenAI's Super Bowl Drama - OpenAI's ad feud with Anthropic escalates as both companies promote their AI products.
New York's AI Regulations - Proposed bills in New York aim to label AI-generated content and pause data center construction.
Crypto.com Makes History - The purchase of AI.com for $70 million marks a record-breaking domain acquisition.
Digital Keys Evolve - The latest Plugfest highlights advancements in digital car key technology among major automakers.
AI in Super Bowl Ads - Brands like Svedka and Anthropic leverage AI in their Super Bowl commercials, igniting debates.
